_help: A 2014-rules background. Add "edition": "2014" to every entry meant for 2014 characters (without it an entry is 2024). 2014 backgrounds have no abilities or feat; they give skills/tools/languages and a background feature. 'equipmentGroups' is a list of separate picks: a single 'Included' option is given automatically.

backgrounds.name: River Guide
backgrounds.description: You ferried travelers and cargo along wild rivers.

feature.name: Riverfolk Welcome
feature.description: Boatmen and dock workers along any river will give you and your companions a ride or a place to sleep.
